name: SPA.js
tagline: Wraps any static site in a persistent, same-origin frame and keeps the title, favicon, and URL bar in sync — so multi-page sites get SPA-style continuity without a router or a framework.

name: CacheBuster.js
tagline: A one-function utility for forcing a hard reload past aggressive browser or CDN caches — useful when you've just shipped a fix and can't wait for a cache to expire.
